title: fix: never overwrite existing best/worst lap values when adding laps
body:
## Summary

Previous fix (PR #23) used a `useRef` to track whether best/worst were manually entered, but this was fragile — the ref could get out of sync with form state (e.g. draft restore, re-renders).

New approach is simpler and deterministic: `syncSummary` now only fills **empty** fields:

```ts
bestLap: f.bestLap.trim() || computed.bestLap,
worstLap: f.worstLap.trim() || computed.worstLap,
```

If best/worst already have values (manually entered or previously computed), they're never overwritten by lap data. `avgLap` always recomputes from laps since it's a derived value. Removed the `manualLapTimes` ref entirely.

Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/e8416ddf4add4559914b0965c29d237d
Requested by: @Litle-Drip
